The ash content (Aad) of the lignite used for co-pyrolysis with sawdust decreased from 7.02% to 0.12% after acid washing.

The decrease in ash content is 6.90 percentage points.

The share of the original ash content that was lowered by acid washing is 6.90 / 7.02 = 98.0%.
